reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 9 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Suns (revenge).
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 77 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 204 and 252 total points.
